title: CaptionTemplate
description: M12A § per-SFX caption template entry (matches cf_audio::caption_bridge::CaptionTemplate). Loaded into the runtime CaptionRegistry at startup; cf-audio::caption_bridge fires ux.captions_shown with the resolved template text on every audio event.

per_language.description: M38A-managed localization map; key = ISO-639 lang code, value = translated template.
